name: Cyclomatic complexity (limit 6)
covers: Flags a Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Rust or Vue function, or one a Blade template's PHP defines, whose cyclomatic complexity, with lizard 1.24.0's decision points, is above 6.
reason: matches Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Blade, Rust or Vue source

rules.title: Keep Python functions at cyclomatic complexity 6 or lower
Keep TypeScript functions at cyclomatic complexity 6 or lower
Keep JavaScript functions at cyclomatic complexity 6 or lower
Keep PHP functions at cyclomatic complexity 6 or lower

caught.text:
<?php
function grade(int $score, bool $late, bool $extra): string
{
    if ($score > 90 && !$late) {
        return 'A';
    } elseif ($score > 80 || $extra) {
        return 'B';
    } elseif ($score > 70) {
        return 'C';
    }
    foreach ([1, 2] as $bonus) {
        if ($bonus > $score) {
            return 'D';
        }
    }
    return 'F';
}

passes.text:
<?php
function grade(int $score, bool $late): string
{
    if ($late) {
        return 'F';
    }
    return $score > 90 ? 'A' : 'B';
}

rules.title: Keep the functions in Blade templates at cyclomatic complexity 6 or lower
Keep Rust functions at cyclomatic complexity 6 or lower
Keep Vue component functions at cyclomatic complexity 6 or lower
